The Petitioner has prayed to issue guidelines and directions with regard to the procedure to be followed in case of default by the DIC/LTA Customers in discharge of their obligations in regard to payment/compliance with Payment Security Mechanism and other obligations, cancellation of Long Term Access in the event of default, encashment of Construction phase Bank Guarantee and payment of relinquishment charges._ _(b) any winding up or bankruptcy or insolvency order is passed against a DIC; or_ 76. The Petitioner has raised the ground of Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) to seek relief. We observe that all the three actions viz. invocation of BG (27.6.2018), termination of TSA (28.11.2018) and revocation of LTA (13.12.2018) were taken by the CTUIL prior to the admittance of the Petitioner Company to the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) vide order dated 5.9.2019 of NCLT, Hyderabad. Hence we do not find any merit in contention of Petitioner.
